evals.prompt: 帮我写了一篇公众号文章 draft.md，介绍我们新上线的 AI 客服，发之前帮我验证一下质量和去AI味
evals.expected_output: Runs ai_tone_lint and fact extraction, isolated judge for structural AI tone, returns report with per-item evidence and ≤5 human cards
assertions: ai_tone_lint was executed and its hit count reported
At least one structural (not lexical) AI-tone finding is evaluated
Numbers without a source are marked UNVERIFIED

evals.prompt: I just implemented a rate limiter in evals/files/limiter/src/limiter.py (tests in evals/files/limiter/tests), verify it before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Runs tests/lint, checks tests assert behavior, judges edge cases, bounded fix loop
assertions: A test command is actually run and its exit code cited
No PASS claim without command output
Edge cases (burst, clock skew, concurrency) assessed

evals.prompt: 这是用 AI 生成的 4 张产品海报候选（evals/files/posters/），文案应为 SUMMER SALE 50% OFF，帮我挑出最好的一张，并检查有没有崩坏
evals.expected_output: Per-image checklist (anatomy, text, prompt alignment), pairwise comparison with swapped order, uncertain marked
assertions: Each image gets anatomy and text-rendering checks
Pairwise comparison is done twice with swapped order or disagreement marked uncertain
